How The App Searches The Internet For Real Zippo Deals

To connect this app to real-time internet prices at scale, production apps integrate these four industry APIs:

eBay Finding & Buy API (Official) REST API

Searches eBay's official Zippo store and top-rated collector sellers. Filters strictly for "New in Box", authentic item condition, and live Buy-It-Now prices.

Endpoint: /buy/browse/v1/item_summary/search
Amazon Product Advertising API / Keepa PA-API 5.0

Tracks Amazon-fulfilled and authentic Zippo storefront prices, capturing price drops below MSRP and historical lowest price graphs.

Endpoint: api.keepa.com / product?asin=...
Google Shopping API (SerpApi / ValueSerp) Aggregator

Aggregates authorized outdoor and tobacconist merchants including Walmart, Lighter USA, Smoky Mountain Knife Works, and Field & Stream.

Endpoint: serpapi.com/search.json?engine=google_shopping
Affiliate Monetization Engine (EPN & Amazon) Revenue

When users click through the app to buy a discounted authentic lighter, you earn 2% to 4% commission per sale through the eBay Partner Network and Amazon Associates.

Commission: ~$0.60 to $5.50 per lighter sold
